cases.title: Peugeot 407 Sedan pre-facelift in Bandung, Jawa Barat 01

cases.notes: Peugeot 407 saloon (pre-facelift), silver, front-left 3/4: front on the left of the frame, left flank running to the right (matches the front-left-45 overlay). cases.title: Mercedes W123 parked by a country road during golden hour near a small town in autumn landscape
cases.author: Shixart1985
cases.notes: Mercedes-Benz 200D (W123, 1976-1985 generation) saloon, teal/blue, near-profile of the right side (nose to the right, seen slightly from the rear), parked on a gravel country road at golden hour: very low sun, long shadow, warm back-lit sky. Car ~53 % of the frame width, whole car visible, eye height. The photographer applied a strong teal/orange colour grade, so the paint colour in the file is already graded - a stress test for light/colour harmonisation, not a colour reference. File is the Wikimedia 3840px-wide rendition of the 6016x4016 original (upload.wikimedia.org rate-limits original downloads).

cases.title: Car parked at the northeast viewpoint at Alexandra Park, Bath 2025-07-22
cases.author: Andy Li
cases.notes: MG ZS EV compact SUV, red, near-profile of the right side (nose to the right, front face only slightly visible, so shotKey right_side rather than front_right_45). Parked at the Alexandra Park viewpoint in Bath (UK) and photographed across the road at eye height with the city panorama behind. The car spans only ~24 % of the frame width (whole car visible) - expected to be rejected as vehicle_too_small. A person standing at the railing overlaps the roofline from behind; a parking meter stands behind the front. File is the Wikimedia 3840px-wide rendition of the 8160x6144 original (upload.wikimedia.org rate-limits original downloads).

cases.title: Lada Samara parked; Dnipro, Ukraine; 22.10.19

Car ~55 % of the frame width, fully inside the frame, no other vehicle in the frame. Thin overhead tram/trolley wires cross the whole frame. Expected to be rejected as perspective_mismatch. File is the Wikimedia 3840px-wide rendition of the 4320x3240 original (upload.wikimedia.org rate-limits original downloads).
